description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Moog Military Aircraft LLC is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to develop software for mission-critical systems on modern military platforms. The role focuses on embedded real-time control systems, device drivers and communication protocols, and system integration in lab and field environments.
Associate Software Engineer developing RTOS/embedded Linux software for real-time control, device drivers, communication protocols, and system integration

Responsibilities:
• Design, code, debug, and integrate software for embedded real-time control systems
• Work with RTOS (real-time operating systems) or embedded Linux
• Develop device drivers and communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, MIL-STD-1553)
• Integrate systems in lab and field environments
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across hardware and systems

Requirements:
• These positions require having a current Security Clearance, or the ability to obtain Security Clearance
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Computer, Software, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
• Either work or academic experience in the design/development/test of embedded real-time control software
• Either work or academic hands-on experience working with integrated hardware/software systems
• Either work or academic experience with control systems and signal processing (Systems Track)
• Either work or academic experience with embedded Linux, cybersecurity tools, or RTOS
